issues.issue: Label says reimbursements; recorded as intergovernmental (county/other local governments). Defensible since it comes from another local government under an interlocal agreement, but it could be reimbursements/refunds. It is 37% of receipts.
The page names no function; utilities is an assumption (could be streets/highways or general government). The line already has a review flag; the same applies to detail[8].

issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print Actual on GAAP Basis, Adjustments, Actual on Budgetary Basis
issues.issue: Detail amounts come from the budgetary-basis actual column, so they won't tie to the GAAP statement on p2 (e.g. GF property taxes 29,308 vs 23,633). Defensible because it's the column next to the budget, and notes say so, but it's a column choice someone should confirm.
